name: Royalty
summary: Royalty DFW is a premium streetwear boutique in Mesquite, Texas, offering an extensive collection of high-end urban fashion brands including Valabasas, A Bathing Ape, Supreme, and Purple Brand. With a 4.9-star rating and focus on exclusive designer denim and contemporary streetwear, it has become a premier destination for fashion-forward shoppers in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
demographics: Royalty DFW attracts a young, fashion-forward demographic primarily consisting of millennials and Gen Z shoppers aged 18-35 with middle to upper-middle income levels. The customer base is heavily influenced by streetwear culture and urban fashion trends, drawn to premium denim brands and designer collaborations. Located in Mesquite, TX, the store serves the greater Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, appealing to style-conscious consumers who follow contemporary fashion trends and seek exclusive, limited-edition pieces from brands like A Bathing Ape, Supreme, and Valabasas.
description: Royalty DFW is a premier streetwear and contemporary fashion destination located at Town East Mall in Mesquite, Texas, serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. This carefully curated boutique specializes in high-end streetwear, designer denim, and exclusive fashion brands that define modern urban style. The store features an impressive collection of sought-after labels including Valabasas, Godspeed, Purple Brand, A Bathing Ape, Supreme, and Billionare Boys Club, alongside emerging brands like Who Decides War and Diet Starts Monday. With a focus on premium skinny and stacked jeans, graphic tees, hoodies, and statement jackets, Royalty DFW has established itself as a go-to destination for fashion enthusiasts seeking the latest drops and limited-edition pieces. The boutique maintains exceptional customer satisfaction with a 4.9-star rating from over 108 reviews, operating seven days a week from 11 AM to 9 PM, and offers convenient perks like free shipping on orders over $150 and a 10% discount code for first-time shoppers.
